title.value: Deep Neural Networks pruning via the Structured Perspective Regularization
title.justification: The title directly reflects the main topic of the paper, which is about a new method for pruning deep neural networks using structured perspective regularization.
title.quote: Deep Neural Networks pruning via the Structured Perspective Regularization

extractions.description: This paper introduces a novel method for pruning deep neural networks through structured perspective regularization. The approach is based on a Mixed-Integer-Programming model and uses perspective reformulation to improve network sparsity while maintaining competitive performance. The algorithm is tested on various neural network architectures and demonstrates effective parameter reduction with minimal impact on model accuracy.
